subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` become a permanent public cron, protocol, hook, and plugin SDK status, or should yielded-parent waiting remain internal until a final outcome exists?
rationale: The branch changes persisted and public contracts across multiple consumers; code correctness cannot determine whether that permanent API and product surface is desired.

options.title: Keep Waiting Internal
options.body: Preserve existing public terminal statuses and represent yielded-parent waiting only in internal lifecycle and task state until settlement.

options.title: Approve Public Deferred Status
options.body: Adopt deferred across persistence, protocol, CLI, UI, hooks, and SDK after migration, upgrade, and consumer-compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Keep Waiting Internal
recommendation.body: Preserve existing public terminal statuses and represent yielded-parent waiting only in internal lifecycle and task state until settlement.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the underlying yielded-pause behavior and is the strongest available owner for whether it should become a public status contract.
